summary: [[character:riker]] and [[character:george-butterworth|Colonel Butterworth]] disagree over whether the colony-ship effort should first search for other surviving [[species:human|humans]]. Riker keeps resource recovery, additional Bobs, shipyard work, and colony-ship construction as the priority, while [[character:homer]] surveys recoverable material and remote outposts. Twenty days later, abandoned outposts and salvaged battle wreckage support a distributed manufacturing plan that sends material to Earth-Moon L4 and L5 and begins the industrial build-up for colony ships.

updates.current_state: At [[location:sol]] with [[character:homer]], prioritizing the resource recovery, replication, shipyard, and manufacturing work needed before colony ships can be built.
Surveying recoverable material and remote outposts to support the colony-ship effort with [[character:riker]].

[[character:riker]] is prioritizing the resource recovery, shipyard, replication, and manufacturing work that must precede colony-ship construction; his earlier decade estimate now appears optimistic.

updates.description: An automated factory used to gather and refine resources and to produce drones. It accepts designs made in virtual space and builds them with [[technology:3d-printers]], [[technology:roamers]], and [[technology:nanites]]. Smaller units at material sites can make a few cargo drones at a time; larger units at Earth-Moon L4 and L5 are being set up to produce Bobs and drones and bootstrap industrial-scale equipment for colony ships.

updates.state: The [[organization:united-states-of-eurasia]] space station is apparently abandoned, with no signs that it was attacked.

updates.description: Is a harsh mistress. [[location:earth]]'s natural satellite; the two Earth–Moon Lagrange points host the Bobs' large [[technology:autofactory|autofactories]], which build Bobs, drones and colony-ship equipment.
